narrative: You step past the threshold of the narrow stone bridge, your boots scraping against the frost-bitten masonry. Before you can utter a word, the Sentry Captain lunges forward, the ashwood shaft of his spear slamming into the cobblestones a mere breath away from your chest. Cold iron gleams in the grey morning light, held steady by trembling, battle-hardened hands. The captain narrows his eyes, his breath pluming into white vapor as he leans in close, his voice a gravelly rasp. "Name and business, traveler," he barks, the tip of his weapon pressing just hard enough against your coat to test your nerve. The other guards lock their grips on their longspears, forming an impenetrable wall of steel across the Ashen Bridge.

choices.text: "My name is of no concern to you, captain; I merely cross the bridge."
Slowly reach into your coat toward a pouch of hidden coin
"I am a traveler from the lowlands, seeking safe passage north."
Shift your weight onto your back foot and prepare to deflect the spear-tip

extractedMemories.summary: Halted at spear-point on the Ashen Bridge by a hostile Sentry Captain demanding identity.
